name: Yuka
source:
A mysterious girl with the face of an angel and the soul of a demon, Yuka has a macabre possessive affection towards [url=/c4736]Kyouji[/url]. She appears and vanishes on a whim, bringing more questions than answers with each arrival, eternally seeking approval in his eyes while bitterly condemning anyone else who draws closer to him.

[Edited from Eroge Review]
